items.text: Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro debuted at #5 in LMArena's Text-to-Image Arena with 1,263 points, up from Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro's #15 and 1,191 points.
items.text_zh: Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro 以 1263 分空降 LMArena 文生图榜第 5，上代 Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro 仅为第 15、1191 分。

items.text: Cognition shipped Devin Fusion in Devin Cloud, saying harness and model gains make it 4% more intelligent and 27% cheaper on FrontierCode 1.1.
items.text_zh: Cognition 在 Devin Cloud 上线 Devin Fusion，称框架与模型改进使其在 FrontierCode 1.1 上智能提升 4%、成本降低 27%。

items.text: Mem0 launched Dream, a background layer that continuously reconciles contradictory memories inside agent projects instead of leaving conflicts to accumulate.
items.text_zh: Mem0 推出 Dream：一个后台层，持续调和 agent 项目中相互矛盾的记忆，避免冲突不断累积。

items.text: Tripo AI won Best in Show at SIGGRAPH Real-Time Live for on-stage game-ready 3D asset generation, with the audience creating over 600 models live.
items.text_zh: Tripo AI 凭现场生成游戏可用 3D 资产夺得 SIGGRAPH Real-Time Live 全场最佳，台下观众现场生成了 600 多个模型。

items.text: Databricks released Omnigent, an open-source AI meta-harness for composing and governing coding and workflow agents in one place.
items.text_zh: Databricks 开源 Omnigent——一个 AI「元框架」，让团队在同一处编排与治理编程及工作流 agent。

items.text: Artificial Analysis launched an Endpoint Accuracy Index measuring how much of an open-weights model's accuracy each serverless API endpoint actually preserves.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 推出 Endpoint Accuracy Index，衡量各家 serverless API 端点究竟保留了开源权重模型多少精度。

items.text: Ollama said DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is its fastest-growing model ever by token usage and that it is scaling capacity in the US and Europe.
items.text_zh: Ollama 称 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 是其史上 token 用量增长最快的模型，正在美欧扩容承接需求。

items.text: The UK AI Security Institute published a cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, which Anthropic amplified.
items.text_zh: 英国 AI 安全研究所发布对 Anthropic Claude Mythos 5 与 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 的网络安全能力评估报告，Anthropic 转发推荐。

items.text: OpenAI disclosed two incidents that occurred during third-party cyber evaluations of its models, detailing what happened and its remediation steps.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 披露其模型在第三方网络安全评测过程中发生的两起事故，说明事发经过与后续整改措施。

items.text: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B for on-device agents, claiming 220 tokens/second on an Apple M5 Max within 2.5GB of memory.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 发布面向端侧 agent 的 LFM2.5-2.6B，称在 Apple M5 Max 上达 220 tokens/秒，内存占用仅 2.5GB。

items.text: Microsoft Research introduced PRISM2, a pathology foundation model trained on 2.3 million whole-slide images and millions of report-derived question-answer pairs.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院发布病理基础模型 PRISM2，基于 230 万张全切片图像与数百万条源自病理报告的问答对训练。

items.text: Pika launched the Pika API Club, a $10-per-month membership offering discounted access to 100-plus video, image, audio and LLM models through one API.
items.text_zh: Pika 推出 Pika API Club：月费 10 美元会员制，通过单一 API 低价调用 100 多个视频、图像、音频与 LLM 模型。

items.text: AWS made Web Search generally available on Amazon Bedrock, grounding models in Amazon's web index via one API parameter with zero data egress.
items.text_zh: AWS 在 Amazon Bedrock 正式上线 Web Search，通过一个 API 参数即可用亚马逊网页索引为模型接地，且默认零数据外流。

items.text: Spotify said Merlin, representing over 30,000 independent labels, joined Universal in backing its opt-in paid AI remix and covers tool.
items.text_zh: Spotify 表示代表逾 3 万家独立唱片公司的 Merlin 已与环球一同支持其需艺人授权的付费 AI 混音与翻唱工具。

items.text: A US appeals court lifted the injunction barring Perplexity's shopping agent from Amazon, ruling that users, not Perplexity, access the platform through the agent.
items.text_zh: 美国上诉法院撤销了禁止 Perplexity 购物智能体访问亚马逊的禁令，认定通过智能体访问平台的是用户本人，而非 Perplexity 公司。

items.text: The White House's voluntary frontier-model cyber testing framework will not cover open-weight models, advisers told AI firms at an August 4 meeting.
items.text_zh: 白宫顾问在 8 月 4 日的会议上告知各 AI 公司，其自愿性前沿模型网络安全测试框架不会覆盖开放权重模型。

items.text: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Super, a 34B open vision-language-action driving model on Hugging Face under the Linux Foundation's permissive OpenMDW-1.1 license.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布 Alpamayo 2 Super，一款 340 亿参数的开放视觉-语言-动作自动驾驶模型，已按 Linux 基金会宽松许可 OpenMDW-1.1 上线 Hugging Face。

items.text: CopilotKit open-sourced the MIT-licensed Channels SDK, letting any AG-UI agent run inside Slack and Microsoft Teams without rewriting its model or orchestration.
items.text_zh: CopilotKit 开源 MIT 许可的 Channels SDK，让任意 AG-UI 智能体无需改动模型与编排逻辑即可运行在 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams 中。

items.text: Microsoft set per-unit AI token budgets and made GPT-5.6 its cheaper internal default, with an executive saying tokenmaxxing is not what it optimizes for.
items.text_zh: 微软为各业务单元设定 AI token 预算，并将更便宜的 GPT-5.6 设为内部默认模型，高管直言公司优化目标不是「堆 token」。

items.text: Startup Infinity says its Ignition agent built CUDA-like GPU software for chipmaker d-Matrix in ten hours, after raising $15 million at a $100 million valuation.
items.text_zh: 初创公司 Infinity 称其 Ignition 智能体用 10 小时为芯片公司 d-Matrix 搭出「类 CUDA」软件，该公司刚以 1 亿美元估值融资 1500 万美元。

items.text: DeepSeek-V4-Flash reshaped Agent Arena's cost-performance frontier with a $0.024 median cost per task, the leaderboard operators said.
items.text_zh: 排行榜运营方表示，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 以每任务 0.024 美元的中位成本，重塑了 Agent Arena 的成本-性能帕累托前沿。

items.text: AMD's data center revenue more than doubled to $6.7 billion, up 107% year over year, as its Helios AI rack platform begins ramping.
items.text_zh: AMD 数据中心营收同比增长 107% 至 67 亿美元，实现翻倍以上增长，其 Helios AI 整机柜平台开始出货爬坡。

items.text: Simon Willison shipped LLM 0.32, adding reasoning traces, the OpenAI Responses API, provider-hosted server-side tools and Git-style content-addressable logging.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 发布 LLM 0.32，新增推理轨迹显示、OpenAI Responses API、厂商托管的服务端工具，以及类 Git 的内容寻址日志存储。

items.text: Alibaba's Taotian opened 2027 graduate hiring with over 90% of roles in AI, centered on AI application engineers and AI agent optimization engineers.
items.text_zh: 阿里淘天启动 2027 届校招，AI 技术类岗位占比超九成，核心岗位包括 AI 应用研发工程师和 AI Agent 优化工程师。

items.text: Genspark added FLUX 3 to its AI Video Agent, bringing native audio, text-to-video, image-to-video and video continuation with multilingual dialogue.
items.text_zh: Genspark 将 FLUX 3 接入其 AI 视频智能体，带来原生音频、文生视频、图生视频和视频续写，并支持多语言对白。

items.text: Alibaba made Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro available on Qwen Cloud and on fal, opening its newest image model to third-party generation platforms.
items.text_zh: 阿里将 Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro 上线 Qwen Cloud 并接入 fal，把其最新图像模型开放给第三方生成平台调用。

items.text: Canva promoted Canva Code, which turns prompts into interactive games, quizzes and widgets, publishing five sample builds including a timed drawing challenge.
items.text_zh: Canva 推广 Canva Code，可将提示词直接变成互动游戏、测验和小组件，并放出五个示例作品，包括一款限时绘画挑战。

items.text: Bending Spoons agreed to buy Airtable, whose platform runs built-in AI data agents, for $1.285 billion cash, far below its $11.7 billion 2021 valuation.
items.text_zh: Bending Spoons 同意以 12.85 亿美元现金收购内置 AI 数据智能体的 Airtable，远低于其 2021 年 117 亿美元的估值。
